GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (27 Jan 46) GC
(SCAPIN-657)
27 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Japanese Diplomatic and Consular Members and Others.
1. Reference is made to C.L.O. No. 342 (5.1), dated 23 January 1946, subject as above.
2. Information from the C.L.O. (Mr Ushiba), 25 January 1946, indicates that the persons listed in above reference letter already have departed Sweden.
3. No further action concerning the repatriation of these individuals will be taken by this headquarters at this time.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel,A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General
